newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan-Swiss group to operate Vietnam oil facility.
newsitem.headline: Japan-Swiss group to operate Vietnam oil facility.

text.p: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd said on Monday it would set up a firm to operate a floating oil production facility in Vietnam with Mitsubishi Corp and Switzerland's Single Buoy Mooring Inc.
A Mitsubishi Heavy spokesman said that the companies involved needed only to sign a formal agreement.
"We've reached an agreement (on the project), and we're just waiting to sign a formal agreement," he said.
Mitsubishi Heavy will build the floating product storage offloading (FPSO) facility, at an estimated cost of eight to nine billion yen, he said.
The facility will be used by Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd, which aims to begin commercial crude production offshore Vietnam in May 1998, the spokesman said.
The FPSO facility receives what is pumped from oil wells and separates crude oil from gas and water.
The facility will then store the crude until it is loaded on to a tanker.
